summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-charts@0.2.6 advertises itself as an amCharts theming library but its dist/index.js is an empty stub (`const index = {}; export { index as default;`). The package's only functional behavior is its preinstall hook: `package.json` declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, and setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscated JS bundle using an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0x0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}`) with hex-mangled identifiers and a large constant table; the filename 'math_init' has no relation to chart theming. Running this bundle under a smuggled alternate runtime at install time bypasses the Node-resolved code path that a chart library would normally use, and the empty `main` means the preinstall payload is the package's entire installer-facing effect. The `@servicetitan/*` scope resembles a well-known vendor, consistent with a scope-compromise or typosquat lure delivering an install-time dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
